title: Several workflows per project, and a shared work pool
summary: Several workflows per project, assignment rules and a work pool, a weekly timesheet, and reference mode for VitraTM memories.

sections.title: Run and assign project work
sections.note: Several workflows per project, and rules for who picks up each step.

items.body: A **Flow** tab with several workflows per project
Assignment rules by language pair, and bulk assign
Claim open tasks from **Available to claim** in **My work**
Change step settings for a single run
Link Assets directories to a project, including files added later

sections.title: Time on tasks
sections.note: Log time against tasks in a weekly grid.

items.body: A weekly timesheet of your tasks
A start and stop timer on every task
Suggestions from your activity, if you opt in
Approve, send back or reopen each person's week
See the cost of time with hourly rates

sections.title: Reference mode for translation memories
sections.note: For Gemini memories: exact matches are reviewed and corrected, and new translations are not saved back.

items.body: Choose **Match** or **Reference** mode for each VitraTM memory
Memory pages show linked term bases, glossaries and style guides
A **Glossary** tab in **Linguistic assets**
Projects: a **Portfolio** page across your projects
Translate Video: exports match the preview frame for frame
Quality: LQA profiles now score with DQF
Uploads: clearer errors, and one failed file no longer stops the rest
Translate Video: subtitles stay in sync at any speed or frame rate
Translate Video: right-to-left subtitles keep their order
Translate Video: uploaded audio stays in place when speed changes
